definition: A discussion group is a group-based format in which participants meet for supportive conversation about their experiences or concerns. In this study context, it served as a structured comparison condition matched to another group intervention.

reasons: The packet supports a structurally matched supportive discussion group used as an active control/comparison condition, but it does not support the broader generic definition that it is a group-based format for supportive conversation about participants’ experiences or concerns.
The definition adds details about how such a group functions in general that are not stated in the source and may overgeneralize beyond this study context.

The packet does not explicitly support the claim that participants meet for “supportive conversation about their experiences or concerns.” It only names a “supportive discussion group (SDG)” without describing its conversational content.
